'''B-Foroon''' was a mucky [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[B-Foroon system/Legends|B-Foroon system]], a part of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was situated on the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]], which linked it to the [[A-Foroon system/Legends|A-Foroon]] and [[C-Foroon system/Legends|C-Foroon systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

Together with [[A-Foroon/Legends|A-Foroon]] and [[C-Foroon]], B-Foroon made up the [[Foroon Worlds]], a trio of celestial bodies remade by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] into [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworlds]] during the [[Standard century/Legends|century]] immediately preceding the [[Declaration of a New Order|dissolution]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. B-Foroon in particular was controlled by the Hutt [[Faljozic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] as well as its [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] retainers.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
B-Foroon was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-16.<ref name="TEA" />
